mutants.why: dpapiProtectsAndAuthenticatesLocalState requires purpose-bound protection so ciphertext cannot be reused across record types.
dpapiProtectsAndAuthenticatesLocalState requires the exact purpose during authentication and rejects a wrong purpose.
dpapiProtectsAndAuthenticatesLocalState requires wrong-purpose and tampered ciphertext to return no plaintext at all.
dpapiProtectsAndAuthenticatesLocalState observes the DPAPI input copy after RAII cleanup and requires every byte to be zero.
credentialDecryptFailureWipesCiphertextAndEntropy requires the scoped failure cleanup to zero the mutable encrypted input copy.
credentialDecryptFailureWipesCiphertextAndEntropy requires the scoped failure cleanup to zero DPAPI entropy too.
